title: 52 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Agreeing & Disagreeing)
description:
Learn 52 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 52 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

PHRASE LIST

AGREEING & DISAGREEING · 同意与反对
• Totally agree with you. - 我完全同意你的看法。  [Wo QUANLIANg tongyi ni de KANFA.]
• Yeah, that makes sense. - 对呀，这话很有道理。  [Dui ya, ZHE hua hen you DAOLI.]
• I see your point. - 我明白你的意思。  [Wo MINGBAI ni de YISI.]
• I agree, no doubt. - 我同意，毫无疑问。  [Wo tongyi, HAO wu yiwen.]
• You’re right, I think. - 你说得对，我觉得。  [Ni shuode DUi, wo JUede.]
• That’s a fair point. - 你这个说法也很公平。  [Ni ZHEge shuofa ye hen GONGping.]

ORDERING FOOD & DINING · 点餐与用餐
• Can I see the menu, please? - 请给我看看菜单。  [QING gei WO kan kan CAI DAN.]
• What’s your most popular dish? - 你们最受欢迎的菜是什么？  [NI MEN ZUI SHOU HUAN YING DE CAI SHI SHEN ME?]
• Do you have vegetarian options? - 你们有素菜吗？  [NI MEN YOU SU CAI MA?]
• I’m allergic to peanuts. - 我对花生过敏。  [WO DUI HUA SHENG GUO MIN.]
• No spicy, please. - 不要放辣。  [BU YAO FANG LA.]
• Could I get it mild? - 可以做清淡一点吗？  [KE YI ZUO QING DAN YI DIAN MA?]
• Is this dish hot and spicy? - 这道菜辣不辣？  [ZHE DAO CAI LA BU LA?]

POSITIVE LIFE · 积极人生
• Turn setbacks into feedback. - 把挫折变成反馈。  [bǎ CUOZHE zhèng chéng fǎnkuì]
• Say no, protect your energy. - 学会拒绝，守住你的能量。  [xuéhuì jùjué, shǒuzhù nǐ de néngliang]
• Celebrate your effort, not just results. - 为努力喝彩，而不仅是结果。  [wèi nǔlì hēcǎi, ér bùjǐn shì jiéguǒ]
• Choose one thing, do it well. - 只选一件事，把它做好。  [zhǐ xuǎn yī jiàn shì, bǎ tā zuòhǎo]
• Make room for rest. - 给自己留点休息的空间。  [gěi zìjǐ liúdiǎn xiūxi de kōngjiān]
• Keep promises, even small ones. - 守住承诺，哪怕只是小小的。  [shǒuzhù chéngnuò, nǎpà zhǐ shì xiǎoxiǎo de]
• Ask better questions today. - 今天问更好的问题。  [jīntiān wèn gèng hǎo de wèntí]

CELEBRATIONS & PARTIES · 庆祝活动与派对
• Let’s toast to good news! - 来，咱们为好消息干杯。  [Lái, zánmen wèi hǎo xiāoxī gān BĒI.]
• Happy birthday, seriously, today! - 生日快乐，今天一定要开心。  [Shēng Rì kuài Lè, jīn Tiān yī dìng yào kāi Xīn.]
• Can I join your party? - 我可以去参加你们的派对吗？  [Wǒ kě yǐ qù cān Jiā nǐmen de pài Duì ma?]
• What time does the celebration start? - 庆祝活动几点开始？  [Qìng Zhù huó Dòng jǐ diǎn kāi Shǐ?]
• Bring snacks, I’ll handle drinks. - 你带点小吃吧，我负责饮料。  [Nǐ dài diǎn xiǎo Chī ba, wǒ fù zé yǐn Liào.]
• We’re meeting for dinner first. - 我们先约个晚饭，再去玩。  [Wǒmen xiān yuē gè wǎn Fàn, zài qù wán.]

MOTIVATION · 动力
• Let curiosity drive your study - 用好奇心带着你学中文  [Yòng hǎo qí xīn dài zhe nǐ xué Zhōngwén]
• Do one tiny task, right now - 先做一件小事, 现在就开始  [Xiān zuò yī jiàn xiǎo shì, xiàn zài jiù kāi shǐ]
• Make mistakes, not excuses - 犯错没关系, 别找借口  [Fàn cuò méi guān xì, bié zhǎo jiè kǒu]
• Say it casually, then improve - 先随口说出来, 再慢慢变准  [Xiān suí kǒu shuō chū lái, zài màn man biàn zhǔn]
• Use music between your tasks - 你忙的时候也可以用音乐提劲  [Nǐ máng de shí hou yě kě yǐ yòng yīn yuè tí jìn]
• Walk and repeat one sentence - 边走边把一句话重复几遍  [Biān zǒu biān bǎ yī jù huà chóu fù jǐ biàn]

CONFIDENCE · 自信
• I can handle this right now. - 我现在就能搞定。  [Wǒ Xiànzài Jiù Néng Gǎo Dìng.]
• My pace is still winning. - 我的节奏也算赢。  [Wǒ De Jié Zòu Yě Suàn Yíng.]
• I trust my own judgment. - 我相信我自己的判断。  [Wǒ Xiāng Xìn Wǒ Zì Jǐ De Pàn Duàn.]
• Say it, even if it's imperfect. - 就说出来，哪怕不完美。  [Jiù Shuō Chū Lái, Nǎ Pà Bù Wán Měi.]
• I belong at this table. - 我配坐在这个桌子旁。  [Wǒ Pèi Zuò Zài Zhè Ge Zhuō Zi Páng.]
• I’ll ask for clarification kindly. - 我会礼貌地问清楚。  [Wǒ Huì Lǐ Mào De Wèn Qīng Chǔ.]
• Today, I choose confidence. - 今天我选自信。  [Jīn Tiān Wǒ Xuǎn Zì Xìn.]

DATING & ROMANCE · 约会与浪漫
• Want to try this new cafe? - 想去试试这家新咖啡馆吗？  [xiǎng qù shì shì zhè jiā xīn kā fēi guǎn ma]
• We should meet after work - 下班后我们见个面吧  [xià bān hòu wǒ men jiàn gè miàn ba]
• Coffee or tea, your pick - 咖啡还是茶，你选吧  [kā fēi hái shì chá, nǐ xuǎn ba]
• I saved you a front seat - 我给你留了前排的位置  [wǒ gěi nǐ liú le qián pái de wèi zhì]
• Let’s go for a sunset walk - 我们去走走看日落吧  [wǒ men qù zǒu zǒu kàn rì luò ba]
• No pressure, we can just chat - 不用有压力，我们就聊聊天  [bú yòng yǒu yā lì, wǒ men jiù liáo liáo tiān]

SUCCESS · 成功
• I’m making progress, step by step. - 我在稳步进步，点点积累。  [Wo zai wenbu JINGBU, dian dian JI LEI.]
• Today, I earned my win. - 今天，我赢得了属于我的成功。  [Jin tian, Wo YING de le shu yu wo de CHENGGONG.]
• Small effort, big results. - 付出一点点，收获大成果。  [Fu chu yi dian dian, shou huo da chengguo.]
